thread:
Oncall Bot: PAGER — SEV P1: High 5xx rate observed in eu-west inference path after a progressive rollout. Alert: 502s >5% over 10m. Paging on-call.
Alex H: I'm on pager. got the alert, looking at dashboards now. which customers reporting?
Deploy Bot: Deployment note: Started regional progressive rollout for model-runtime v3 -> v2 fallback across eu and apac at 10% gradient. Rollout ID: roll-2025-09-eu-042.
Sasha R: Seeing spikes from edge-pop eu-2 specifically. 502s and some timeouts to inference backends. apac slightly elevated but much lower.
Alex H: Any recent infra changes? config, flags, or LB rules?
Maya P: We flipped feature flag "rollout.gradient" to enable v3 in eu. It should be at 10% across eu. I pushed the flag change ~12m ago.
NetOps: Checking edge weights now. quick curl: `curl -s "https://edge-control.internal/weights?region=eu"` shows: v3=38%, v2=62% for eu-2, while eu-1 reports v3=10%. Seems eu-2 didn't pick up flag rollout and is routing heavier to v3 due to stale local override.
CJ: Oof. That mismatch could explain partial impact. Can we flip a kill-switch on the flag?
Maya P: Initiating kill-switch for eu in FF service: `./ffctl set rollout.gradient eu 0` — running now.
Alex H: After kill-switch, do edges immediately switch? TTLs might keep old configs. We might need LB override.
NetOps: Confirming — ff change acknowledged by control plane but edge-pop eu-2 still returns older config from local cache. TTL on that cache is 5m but cache invalidation failed earlier during maintenance window.
Sasha R: Edge-pop eu-2 also shows stale DNS entries for v3 endpoint behind a local LB. DNS TTL there is 120s but upstream propagation seems stuck, some requests still hitting v3 pool.
Support L3: Customer impact: 4 customers reported 502s to hosted API, two of them are on dedicated EU contracts. Tickets #INC-8312, #INC-8313 created.
Alex H: Plan: 1) apply LB-level override to force 100% to v2 in eu, 2) purge edge-pop config / restart proxy on eu-2, 3) disable rollout.gradient globally if needed. Execute in that order.
NetOps: Applying LB override now: `lbctl override --region eu --target v2 --weight 100` — applied.
Deploy Bot: LB override recorded: roll-2025-09-eu-042 -> override to v2 at 1759001450.
Sasha R: Triggering edge config purge on eu-2: `ssh edge-eu-2 'curl -X POST http://localhost:8090/purge-config || sudo systemctl restart edge-proxy'` — first purge returned 403, restart initiated.
Maya P: After restart, edge-pop eu-2 picked up new config and is returning v2 routes.
Alex H: Observed 502 rate fall from 6.2% -> 0.8% within 2m of LB override + proxy restart. Monitoring window started.
Support L3: Notified customers that we've applied fallback; asking if errors cleared on their side. Two customers confirmed success, two still seeing intermittent failures (investigating correlation with client-side caching).
CJ: Good. Root cause hypothesis: inconsistent propagation of the feature-flag (control plane ok) + stale local edge cache + DNS/edge routing mismatch produced a cross-region gradient mismatch. The canary still had higher error surface on v3 exposing the problem.
Alex H: For immediate mitigation: keep LB override in place until postmortem. We'll also disable the rollout flag globally to prevent other edges from diverging.
Maya P: Disabling rollout.gradient globally: `./ffctl set rollout.gradient global 0` — applied at 1759001745. Confirmed propagation to control plane.
NetOps: We'll schedule forced cache invalidation for all eu pops. Also creating a short-term automation to detect per-pop weight skew > 10% vs control plane.
Sasha R: Collected logs from eu-2 and v3 backend. Attaching sample errors to the incident ticket. Error pattern: upstream connection resets and 500 errors during model init under load.
Support L3: SLA impact: ~15 minutes of degraded service for subset of EU customers; drafting customer note for legal & account teams.
CJ: Actions and owners: Maya (postmortem + FF plumbing), NetOps (cache invalidation + LB guardrail), Sasha (logs + repro), Alex (monitoring + runbook updates), Support L3 (customer comms).
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2025-1397 created. Severity P1 -> mitigated. Handoff scheduled to follow-up squad.
Maya P: I'll lead the follow-up and postmortem. Will open a detailed postmortem doc and include timeline, root cause, and remediation plan. Estimated 48h for full RCA + fixes.
Alex H: Thanks team. Leave LB override up until we have verified fixes and tests around FF propagation + edge invalidation. :thumbsup:
CJ: Also propose adding a canary gating check: if v3 error rate > baseline by X% in any pop, auto-pause rollout. Filing an RFC for that.
Sasha R: Adding that as a follow-up in the postmortem doc.
Support L3: Closing loop with customers — sending follow-up note and workaround details.
Alex H: All good. Monitoring continues. Will update thread if anything regresses.
Maya P: Postmortem doc draft link (will add when ready) — tagging @CJ for review.
Oncall Bot: Incident resolved. If anything re-triggers, it will reopen this thread.
